Astralis is a Danish professional esports organization founded in January 2016. Astralis are one of the most successful organizations in the history of Counter-Strike with 4 Majors and a record 406 consecutive days at #1 on HLTV's team ranking from April 2018 to June 2019.

It was partially owned by players of the former Danish Team SoloMid/Team Questionmark lineup. The rights to the Astralis name were obtained from the original founders of the Finnish Counter-Strike team. [1]

Trivia

[edit]
  • Named the Esports Team of the Year at the Esports Awards 2018. [103][104]
  • Won the most CS:GO Majors in history with 4: ELEAGUE Atlanta 2017, FACEIT London 2018, IEM Katowice 2019, and StarLadder Berlin 2019.
  • Winning IEM Katowice Major 2019 made Astralis the third team to win back-to-back Majors (after Fnatic and Luminosity Gaming/SK Gaming), and the second to win three Majors in total (after Fnatic).
  • The only team to win 3 consecutive Majors, doing so at FACEIT London 2018, IEM Katowice 2019, and StarLadder Berlin 2019.
  • The first team to win a Major without losing a map in the playoffs, doing so at FACEIT London 2018, IEM Katowice 2019, and StarLadder Berlin 2019.
  • Has the second-longest top 4 streak in CS:GO and CS2 Big Events history with 19 consecutive top 4 placements. [105]
  • Hold a 31-match LAN win streak on Nuke. The streak lasted from February 2018 until May 2019 when ENCE defeated them at BLAST Pro Series: Madrid 2019. [106]
  • Hold the record for the longest reign as #1 on HLTV's Team Ranking with 406 consecutive days, starting from April 2018 to June 2019 when they were dethroned by Team Liquid. [107]
  • The first team to feature all players of a roster in the same edition of HLTV's Top 20 Players of the Year, doing so in 2018 with dev1ce, dupreeh, Xyp9x, gla1ve and Magisk.
